Before / After

Drag the line. That's the whole pitch.

Cracked, heaved concrete is where most of our projects start. Slide each handle to see the transformation a tear-out and a fresh paver surface makes.

BeforeAfter

The driveway rescue

Alligator-cracked concrete out, interlocking pavers in — individual stones can be lifted and re-leveled years later instead of re-pouring the whole slab.

BeforeAfter

The patio comeback

A sunken, trip-hazard slab becomes a herringbone patio with a soldier-course border — the pattern J.I.P. reviewers keep writing about.

The Trust Shelf

Seven straight years of Best of Houzz. Paperwork to match.

J.I.P. Construction Corp was founded in Westbury in 2008 by Jose Alfonso Pineda, who worked the trade for more than a decade before hanging his own shingle. The company is fully licensed, bonded and insured, licensed in Nassau and Suffolk Counties, and carries NYC MBE and OSHA credentials — the combination commercial clients require and homeowners should ask for.
